payout_quote: Beginning May 21, 2026, for a limited time only, eligible new WSECU members can earn a $300 cash bonus by meeting all the following requirements: 1. Open a Cash Back Checking account within 14 days of becoming a member.
steps: Qualify for WSECU membership (anyone who lives in Washington state per WSECU membership rules; soft credit pull identity verification for new members)
Join WSECU and open a Cash Back Checking account within 14 days of becoming a member, using promo code CASHBACK300 when opening
Set up direct deposit in the first 90 days to receive $1,000+ per month (payroll, government benefits, or retirement income electronic deposits only - transfers, mobile deposits, P2P excluded)
Complete 25 eligible debit card purchases in the first 90 days (tap/chip/swipe/online/subscription; cash advances, ATM, bill pay, and transfers excluded)
The $300 bonus is deposited within 14 days after all requirements are met in the 90-day qualification period
catches: New members only - existing WSECU members and anyone who closed a WSECU checking account within the last 24 months are excluded
Account must be opened within 14 days of becoming a member
$1,000/month direct deposit is a high bar and must be payroll/government/retirement income - account transfers and P2P do not qualify
25 debit card purchases in 90 days in addition to the $1,000/month DD
Offer is 'limited time' with no stated end date - may be withdrawn without notice
Cannot be combined with other promotions; limit one bonus per member
Account must remain open and in good standing to receive the bonus
New members undergo a soft credit pull for identity verification (does not affect credit scores); credit freezes must be removed
biggest_catch: $1,000+ direct deposit per month for three months PLUS 25 debit purchases in 90 days - and the limited-time offer can be withdrawn without notice.
eligibility: New WSECU members (WA) opening Cash Back Checking within 14 days of membership; no existing WSECU checking and none closed in the last 24 months; one bonus per member.
timing: DD + 25 debit purchases completed within the first 90 days; $300 deposited within 14 days after all requirements are met.
weasel_words: Offer may be modified or withdrawn at any time without notice
